description: Look at web pages in a private server browser: read rendered text, measure element sizes and positions, sample exact colours, time page loads and interactions, inspect animations, check phone, tablet and desktop sizes and dark mode, click and type with approval, and attach screenshots to the reply. Public sites open signed out; the WebAgent app opens signed in as the current user.
skill_summary: Private server browser: signed out on public sites behind an egress guard, signed in as the current user on the WebAgent app; read, measure, colours, timing, animations, viewport and screenshots.

settings.label: Sign in to WebAgent
settings.hint: Opening the WebAgent app signs the browser in as the person chatting, with only their own permissions. Turn off to open it signed out.

settings.label: Allowed sites
settings.hint: Hosts separated by commas or new lines, for example example.com. Each covers its subdomains. Leave empty to allow any public site.

settings.label: Blocked sites
settings.hint: Hosts the agent may never open, separated by commas or new lines; each covers its subdomains. Internal and private addresses are always blocked.
